teaching.example_zh: 那是一辆好看的自行车。

extra_examples.en: He has a good-looking red car.
extra_examples.zh: 他有一辆好看的红色汽车。

teaching.student_prompt: 选一件你喜欢的物品，说 It is good-looking。
teaching.cloze_zh: 那是一辆好看的自行车。
teaching.note: 原创 KET 课堂例句；先读单词与例句，再学习构词或常用搭配。

word_study.explanation_zh: good 是“好的”，looking 在这里说的是“看起来的样子”。good-looking 表示外表好看，中间用连字符连接。

family.connection_zh: looking 来自 look；look nice 也能说“看起来好看”。

example.zh: 这辆自行车看起来很好看。

family.connection_zh: good 是 good-looking 的一个组成词。

challenge.prompt_zh: 把 good 和 looking 连接起来，写出“好看的”。

images.alt: 一辆漂亮的珊瑚红自行车靠在花园矮墙旁，车篮中放着几朵小花。
images.caption: That is a good-looking bike.
images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the edit target. Preserve this exact landscape 3:2 photograph of the coral bicycle, flowers, garden wall, wheels, basket, lighting and composition. Remove all tiny labels, brand plaques, logos and lettering from the bicycle frame, head tube, seat and rims, replacing them with matching plain paint or leather. No text or symbols anywhere. Do not change anything else.

generation_history.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: one classroom vocabulary photograph for Chinese primary-school KET learners; landscape 3:2, ideally 1536x1024.
Style: beautiful playful realistic editorial photography, bright natural daylight, rich plausible colours, real materials and textures, correct anatomy, uncluttered composition, clear main subject for a large projector.
Constraints: no embedded text, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, decorative frames, cartoons or clipart. All people fictional, children fully clothed in ordinary appropriate clothes. Generous margins, no clipped main subject, safe friendly scenes.
Primary request: A visually beautiful, well-kept coral-red city bicycle with a small wicker basket holding a few cheerful yellow flowers, leaning against a low pale garden wall in warm natural daylight. The complete bicycle is visible with correct real wheels, spokes, chain, pedals, basket and handlebars, no brand or writing. An attractive everyday object, teaching good-looking through the bike's appealing appearance; no people or appearance comparisons.
